# About Alaska Airlines


At Alaska Airlines, we’re more than a means of getting from point A to B — we’re a team of passionate people committed to connecting our guests to the world through a remarkable travel experience rooted in safety, care and performance.


Our journey began over 90 years ago connecting remote villages across Alaska. Today, our wings span destinations around the globe, yet our heartfelt dedication to the communities we serve and to delivering genuine, caring service continues to guide us every step of the way.


From where we started to where we’re headed, we’re proud of our story of innovation and adventure — and we look forward to sharing the next chapter with you onboard.


[Visit alaskaair.com](https://www.alaskaair.com/)


## APEX FIVE STAR™ Major Airline


Recognized for outstanding service and performance by the Airline Passenger Experience Association (APEX)


## No. 1 airline loyalty program


Atmos™ Rewards named "Best Airline Rewards Program" by Nerdwallet and "Best Innovation in Airline Loyalty" by The Points Guy.


## Corporate citizenship leader


Celebrated for its commitment to arts and culture by the Puget Sound Business Journal


## West Coast favorite


Offering the most flights from the U.S. West Coast to more than 140 destinations


## Sustainability influencer


Proudly operating as the most fuel-efficient premium airline in the U.S.


## Our history


For over nine decades, Alaska Airlines and the people behind it have been driven by integrity, care, ingenuity, professionalism and a spirit as rugged and resilient as our roots. That spirit was forged in the wild landscapes of Alaska — where aviation wasn’t a luxury, but a lifeline.


Our story began in 1932, when Linious “Mac” McGee launched McGee Airways by hand-painting the name onto a three-passenger plane and flying essential supplies out of Anchorage. What started as a bold solution to bridge vast, roadless terrain soon grew — through grit and a pioneering mindset — into what became Alaska Airlines in 1944. From those humble beginnings, we’ve charted a course toward innovation, service and connecting people and places with care that’s always grounded in our roots.


[See how it all began](https://www.alaskaair.com/content/about-us/history)


## Our community impact


At Alaska Airlines, we believe in strengthening and supporting the communities our employees, neighbors and guests call home. Across our network, we connect young people to career opportunities, invest in local nonprofits from our foundation grants, and partner with organizations nationwide — making our flights a force for good.


[Learn how we give back](https://www.alaskaair.com/content/about-us/corporate-impact/people-communities)


## Careers and opportunities


From fueling career pathways to accelerating innovation and increasing representation to setting meaningful sustainability goals, the most care in the air starts here. Apply today for career opportunities across Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines and Horizon Air.


[Explore open roles](https://careers.alaskaair.com/)
